parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A wooden leg of the table providing vertical support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the tabletop and maintains the table’s stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move relative to the tabletop.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden side panel connecting the legs and supporting the drawer structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides lateral stability and forms the side boundary of the drawer compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move relative to the tabletop.

parts.Functional_description: It provides lateral stability and forms the side boundary of the drawer compartment.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A wooden drawer that fits into the table frame.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for storing small items and can be pulled out or pushed in.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in and out of the table frame.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A wooden back panel located behind the drawer compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and prevents the drawer from sliding out the back.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move relative to the tabletop.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: The flat wooden surface forming the top of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for placing objects, writing, or working.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move relative to the legs or frame.
